cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Shtrader LA is an offline-first trading intelligence agent. It pairs local language-model reasoning with deterministic financial risk mathematics (position sizing, risk/reward, account risk limits) so retail traders in low-connectivity, low-budget environments can analyse trade ideas and enforce risk discipline entirely on an 8 GB laptop. The finance discipline is load-bearing: every numeric result is produced by audited deterministic tools, not by the model, and the agent is prohibited from executing trades.

test_prompts.prompt: My account balance is $1,000 and I risk 1% per trade. I want to buy EUR/USD near 1.0800 with a stop loss at 1.0750 and a take profit at 1.0950. Analyse this trade idea: give me the risk/reward ratio, the capital at risk, whether the setup meets a minimum 2:1 requirement, and the main risks I should watch.

Build me a structured trading plan for swing-trading Bitcoin with a $2,000 account and a maximum 2% risk per trade and 6% daily drawdown limit. Include entry criteria, invalidation rules, position sizing method, and the exact checks I must run before I place any order.
